task.title: Harden source and search production posture
task.summary_zh: 收斂 source/search staging/prod posture：Postgres/object-store backend 強制、metrics/health/alerts、idempotency、compose profiles、end-to-end smoke。
acceptance: staging production env rejects jsonl only source search backend
Postgres and object store ownership are documented and enforced
health live ready metrics expose consistent service state
idempotency keys protect ingest index and reindex commands
end-to-end smoke covers connector to evidence to index to BFF query
